spans.s: योनि m.f. 1. Womb, uterus; 2. place of birth, origin, spring, योनिश्च हि गीयते S.Bh.i.4, K.S.iv.43, Bg.v.22; 3. a mine; 4. a repository, a seat; 5. home, abode, nest; 6. a form of existence, race, birth (e.g. पक्षियोनि), M.xii.53; 7. water.
योनी f. The same as योनि q.v.
योनि-गुण m. quality of a womb or place of origin.
योनि-ज a. born of the womb, viviparous.
योनि-भ्रंश m. fall of the womb, prolapsus uteri.
योनि-संकर m. mixture of caste by unlawful intermarriage, M.x.60.
